LIST DEFINITION 0
  LEVEL 0 bullet "•" indent=760/360
  LEVEL 1 bullet "◦" indent=1160/360
  LEVEL 2 bullet "▪" indent=1560/360
LIST DEFINITION 1
  LEVEL 0 decimal "%1." indent=760/360
  LEVEL 1 lowerLetter "%2." indent=1160/360
  LEVEL 2 decimal "%3)" indent=1560/360
LIST 1 definition=0
LIST 2 definition=1 restarts
